question: Which bounded surviving CPU readers prevent treating draw-path dirty, mode, shader-cache and allocator writes as command-only state?

scope.invocationBoundary: Draw entries, commit and their skipped descendants are consumed for those invocations. Setters, getters, creators, Release, reset, Clear, Resolve, tiling, present and title code survive. A helper remains live through a surviving caller.
scope.qualification: Positive static reader joins and bounded syntax inventories. This is not complete copied, indexed, rebased, bulk, partial-width, indirect or runtime reader closure, and does not admit a draw consume.

dependencies.use: Owns the writer, persistent patch destination, mode and fence boundaries.
Owns API roles, table dispatch and the nine accepted inline dirty writers.
Owns retained object identities, API aliases and the distinct wider replacement policy.
Owns resource-header fences, scratch units, allocator and completion qualifications.
Owns list replay, external destinations and unresolved worker aliases.

currentEvidence.method: Serial foreground no-analysis read-only queries through tools/run-headless.ps1. Maintained ghidra/DumpMemoryWords.java supplied semantic native words; ghidra/FindDirectCallers.java supplied bounded raw direct-BL inventories; ghidra/FindGlobalAddressAccesses.java, ghidra/FindSplitConstantCandidates.java and ghidra/DumpReferences.java supplied counter-address leads. Aligned raw-word and generated instruction-comment scans supplied syntactic field candidates; narrow exact-function generated windows supplied register-flow corroboration.

inputQualification.qualification: Fresh sequential comparison confined differences to the historical thunk band. Cited semantic windows avoid it. Regional equivalence does not establish original thunk semantics or whole-image reader absence.

scanBoundary.rawForms: D-form address formation and scalar load/store opcodes 14,32..55 plus DS forms58/62. Selected high-field overlap starts were scanned globally; low offsets0..0x70 only in [0x82680000,0x826D0000). No result cap was used.
scanBoundary.generatedCheck: Every matched displacement/base-register encoding was checked against supported flat words. This validates candidate locators, not base provenance or complete instruction semantics.
scanBoundary.qualification: The untruncated decoded scan missed known D3D fields because function/listing coverage was sparse. Raw candidates include code, data and undefined bytes. None of these counts proves object identity, arbitrary aliases or runtime execution.

dirtyReaders.directModel: All319 raw ld/ext0 candidates for non-SP offsets0..0x27 in [0x82680000,0x826D0000) matched generated instructions. Of these,277 were classified G reads,9 other fields and33 unresolved aliases. Nine accepted inline owners added24 G reads. Partial-width, indexed and bulk forms were not closed.
dirtyReaders.localTransfers: The277 surviving classified G reads contained210 local OR and2 shader-metadata ANDC transfers plus65 retained flush-chain reads. SetPixelShader reads G+0x8 at0x82692A00 and stores its ANDC at0x82692A0C; SetVertexShader reads G+0x0 at0x82692D10 and stores its ANDC at0x82692D1C. Old dirty values did not select a local branch or API result before these same-field transfers.
dirtyReaders.use: These families test/mask G+0x10/+0x18/+0x20, invoke shared emission helpers and clear selected groups. ACC60 writes the resulting G+0x30 at0x826ACD14 and may enter a command-space slow path. Extra emission alone does not prove an observable API-result difference or prove equivalent redundant work.
dirtyReaders.boundedOmissionCandidates: G+0x0/+0x8 have only local OR/ANDC surviving reads in this direct/API model. G+0x18 retained emission uses mask0x007FFFFC00000000, bits34..54, excluding low32 fetch bits. These are local projection results, not universal never-clear policies.
dirtyReaders.qualification: Whole-qword sticky equivalence remains unresolved. Close partial-width/alias readers, ACFF8 tail/indirect ingress and retained cursor/allocation consequences before selecting it.

exactCpuNibble.condition: r5==0 selects G+0x2884; other values select indexed render-state words. Resolve reaches the helper at0x8269E8DC when flags include0x100, with the selected local control word's low three bits as r5.
exactCpuNibble.use: The selected format nibble at bits16..19 drives CPU table/helper selection and G+0x2A30/+0x2A34 writes. Preserve the exact mode-folded nibble for this retained path.
exactCpuNibble.setterQualification: Setter0x8268E908 reads G+0x2884 at0x8268E98C but masks out its old nibble before merging a new one. That RMW alone does not require the old nibble.

modeReaders.rebasedPayload: Clear at0x826A24B0 and Resolve at0x8269E9D4 pass G+0x2920 to ACC60; mask0x1F000 selects five contiguous words. ACC60 rebases the pointer and loads at0x826ACCF8, with AC610 providing the slow copy path. This includes G+0x2924/+0x2928 despite their direct-load negatives. Similar retained families pass G+0x2880 and the same G+0x2920 block. Loaded values were payload-only in these inspected copy paths; existing host consumers remain separate obligations.
modeReaders.controlEffects: G+0x2940 is passed by Clear0x826A2464 and Resolve0x8269E988 to AC8C8; bit0 can change CPU command-construction branching/cursor length, while lowbit1 was payload-only in the inspected paths. Resolve tests G+0x2ABE mask0x08 at0x8269ECE0 and clears it at0x8269ED20 after its selected synchronization sequence. Omission needs an explicit cursor/helper equivalence contract.
modeReaders.bitPrecision: AC6C8 changes G+0x2940 bits0/1 and G+0x2ABD mask0x04, not mask0x10. Render-state getters return other G+0x2940 bits or byte G+0x2942. Present's G+0x2ABE mask0x10 test does not read the draw-written0x08/0x40/0x80 values.
modeReaders.boundedDeadCandidates: No retained direct G-derived reader of G+0x2954/+0x319C was identified. Inspected retained direct uses allowed stale G+0x2ABD mask0x04 and G+0x2ABE masks0x40/0x80. Arbitrary aliases and raw-only candidates remain unresolved.
modeReaders.qualification: Neither a fullword load nor a preserved unrelated flag proves all bits observable. Payload-only copies do not by themselves require exact values when payload is discarded. They also do not prove complete omission safe.

persistentReaders.layout: R_v=VS+0x1A0*v. Declaration tag=VD+0x30; variant tag=R_v+0x28; stride qwords=R_v+0x30/+0x38; variant fence stamp=R_v+0x40; saved source fetch records start atR_v+0x44. Literal VS+0x48..0x63 overlaps saved records, not the stride cache.
persistentReaders.cachedStride: SetStreamSource0x8268FB08 forms G+stream and reads byte G+0x2E38+stream at0x8268FC08 when full unsigned stride>>2 is nonzero. Comparison inequality ORs dirty0x80000. Exact cached bytes preserve the branch; stale bytes require a proved redundant-dirty protocol. The two UP comparison readers are consumed.

cpuCodeCopy.condition: A nonnull destination selects the copy arm; null only reports metadata-plus-code size.
cpuCodeCopy.use: Load C=word(VS+0x20), M=word(VS+0x36C), S=word(VS+0x370), then request a copy of S code bytes from C to destination+M after copying metadata from VS+0x368. This reads the persistent code allocation patched by the consumed selector.
cpuCodeCopy.callerClosure: 0x82662D28 calls0x82694480 at0x82662D60 for size and0x82662DF8 for the nonnull copy. Its owner-derived shader record supplies resource+4 and buffer+8. On device mismatch it releases the resource and calls0x825E0248 to recreate it from the retained buffer. Direct upstream clients call0x82662D28 at0x825E1D2C and0x8265E26C after record+0x14 bit0x80000000 and nonnull-resource tests.
cpuCodeCopy.obligation: Preserve the exact requested code bytes for a retained readback of the patched resource, or provide an equivalent readback contract. Consuming draw entries alone does not eliminate this CPU reader.
cpuCodeCopy.qualification: Actual ordered identity with a previously patched VS, optional buffer vtable+0xC targets, copy helper effects and ranges remain guarded. No runtime activation, save/reset semantic name or universal resource-alias closure is claimed.

persistentReaders.gettersAndLifetime: GetVertexShader0x82692E18 returns/AddRefs G+0x3198; GetVertexDeclaration0x82692E78 returns/AddRefs G+0x2E2C. Their inspected bodies do not read cache prefixes or code. Release0x826981D8 and type6 cleanup0x82697AA8 read resource header+4/+8 and the VS code pointer for freeing, not variant stamp+0x40 or code bytes. Resource header+8 and variant stamp are distinct.
persistentReaders.constructorBoundary: Init0x82692B50 reads code records and snapshots them at R_v+0x44+12*i. Its sole raw direct caller is CreateVS0x826946BC after fresh allocation/code copy. It did not establish a retained post-patch use of the initializer.
persistentReaders.boundedDeadCandidates: Identified VD tag, variant tag/stride/stamp, saved fetch record and ID counter readers were inside consumed selector/patcher paths. The readback API excludes the cache prefix. Optional creation callbacks and copied/indexed/bulk aliases keep global absence unresolved.
persistentReaders.counterSearch: Counter0x82FA0544 had one decoded materializer and one raw8-word split candidate at0x826ADD1C/0x826ADD20, zero database xrefs, with caps256/8 not reached. The atomic increment is at0x826ADD30/0x826ADD38. Long-distance/copied/indexed aliases are outside that search.

listAndAllocatorReaders.rebasedCursor: EndTiledList0x826AC218 forms L=G+0x33C0 at0x826AC2BC and calls0x8269B508 at0x826AC2C0. For nonnull L+4, B508 reads L+8=G+0x33C8 at0x8269B514/0x8269B538, links the tail and writes the terminator through that cursor. Direct G+0x33C8 negatives therefore do not establish deadness.
listAndAllocatorReaders.listGrowth: 0x8269C170 reads L+8 at0x8269C190/0x8269C1FC and updates the list descriptor through allocation/linking. Retained list initialization/finalization/submission share this protocol. Exact descriptor/record storage or a replacement list contract is needed while those readers survive; complete record-byte/replay/reclaim closure remains open.
listAndAllocatorReaders.sharedPools: 0x8269B618 reads G+0x3A44 at0x8269B634 and G+0x3A4C at0x8269B6B4/0x8269B780 to select allocation addresses and wrap/wait paths.0x826A6848 reads G+0x3A44 at0x826A685C and cursor/limits to choose a pointer or failure and lower limits.0x8269B818 reads G+0x3A54 at0x8269B888 and G+0x3A4C at0x8269B8B4 for used-byte accounting and threshold cursor/limit writes.
listAndAllocatorReaders.snapshot: 0x8269B0E0 snapshots G+0x30/+0x34 and G+0x3A4C/+0x3A44 at0x8269B0E0/0x8269B0E4/0x8269B0EC/0x8269B0F0; retained BeginTiledList calls it at0x826AC0C8.0x8269B118 restores the saved pool/cursor words.
listAndAllocatorReaders.dirtyAllocationFrontier: Skipped dirty emission can change G+0x30 and command-space paths before allocation. B618's zero-cursor alternatives and A6848's collision test consume shared cursor/limits. Entry-only arithmetic does not close newly admitted dirty allocation, manager, wait, growth, threshold or failure paths.
listAndAllocatorReaders.qualification: Preserve exact shared-pool behavior on admitted paths or replace its observable allocation contract. The low-offset cursor inventory includes other-object collisions; it is not complete G provenance. Returned scratch extents, existing host staging and post-commit lifetime remain governed by the completion contract.

nextDiscriminator: Close the explicit unclassified dirty aliases, partial-width/indexed/bulk overlaps, escaped getter-created object aliases and raw-only code/data candidates before an exhaustive reader-absence claim.
Bind retained command discard, cursor/helper and allocator observations to concrete masks/inputs before claiming whole dirty-qword or derived-flag stale equivalence.
Bind a retained CPU readback's ordered resource identity and buffer/copy targets, or implement an equivalent readback bridge before omitting patched guest code.
Close tail/indirect patcher and constant-flush ingress, counter aliases, full tile-record decoder/reclaim and actual dirty allocation paths before broadening admission.
guards: Do not call surviving dirty readers OR-only, or infer whole-qword sticky equivalence from local same-field transfers.
Do not call patched VS code GPU-only; a surviving CPU code-copy and conditional recreation chain is identified.
Do not conflate decimal40/48/64 with hexadecimal offsets0x40/0x48/0x64, resource-header fences with variant stamps, or flag mask0x04 with bit index4.
Do not equate direct-load absence with rebased, indexed, copied or bulk reader absence.
Do not infer runtime activation, complete API cut equivalence, allocator ownership, scratch lifetime or safe consume admission from this static result.
conclusion: The draw-only cut retains a CPU shader-code copy/recreation path, exact Resolve color-format nibble use, cached-stride comparison, masked dirty flushes and rebased list/shared-pool readers. Some cache-prefix, flag and dirty-bit writes are bounded omission candidates, but complete reader and observation closure remains unresolved.
